name: 6AN Braided Black Nylon Hose / Line (E85 + Race Fuel Safe) - 10ft roll
title: 6AN Braided Black Nylon Hose / Line (E85 + Race Fuel Safe) - 10ft roll
description:
Whether you’re a professional building a 6-second NHRA bracket car, a perfectionist designing the ultimate engine bay for a SEMA car, or an HPDE enthusiast looking to improve your oil temps, the products are designed for all flavors of motorsports. 



ColorFittings Nylon and Stainless-steel Braided AN Hose is universally compatible. Common uses include motor oil, gas, E85, race-fuel, and coolant. For more detail about ColorFittings AN Hose, refer here.



The 6AN diameter Nylon & Stainless-steel braided AN Hose operates at a 500PSI threshold, and boasts a 2000PSI burst threshold. 



For a hassle-free installation process, Color-Fittings strongly recommend using the Fitting Assembly Tools. 



Our Nylon & Stainless-steel braided AN Hose pairs excellently with the lightweight Hose Separators, which are available in unique gloss-finish colors.
